kernel.governing_law: Guilt is discovered not by evidence but by the fact that the guilty hide; the interrogation is not inquiry but the forcing of confession from those who already know what they have done — sovereignty speaks so that shame will speak back.
kernel.mutated_relation: Every utterance in the scene presupposes a prior collapse of relation — the conditions that make each speech-act possible are: a presence that was once un-flinched-from is now flinchable; a body that was once unmarked is now legible; a gift that was once binding is now deflectable — and stating these conditions directly replaces the drama with its understructure.
kernel.beats:
heard -> had become the kind who could be startled by
the voice of the LORD God -> what had until then been indistinguishable from their own breathing
walking in the garden -> a displacement where there had been no distance
the cool of the day -> the first air that had a temperature
Adam and his wife -> two who now required naming from each other
hid themselves -> performed the act that invented concealment
the presence of the LORD God -> the condition of being-seen they had never previously distinguished from being
amongst the trees of the garden -> into what had only now become cover
called unto Adam -> used the voice as a summons, which requires that arrival is no longer automatic
Where art thou -> the question whose askability means location has replaced intimacy
I heard thy voice -> I experienced you as separate source
in the garden -> in what is now a place rather than a surround
I was afraid -> I had acquired the capacity for orientation-toward-threat
because I was naked -> because my surface had become information
I hid myself -> I became the first thing that subtracted itself from the visible
Who told thee -> what mediation now stands between you and your own condition
that thou wast naked -> that your body is a legible text
Hast thou eaten of the tree -> have you performed the act whose possibility I installed by forbidding it
I commanded thee -> I made refusal possible and therefore made compliance a sustained act rather than a default
thou shouldest not eat -> the not that created the eat as chooseable
The woman whom thou gavest -> the gift now recast as cause — which requires that receiving has become a grievance
she gave me -> agency has become transferable, passable, deflectable
of the tree -> of the tree (RETAIN: the tree is the constant around which the conditions pivot — it is what remains identical while every relation to it transforms)
and I did eat -> and I entered the condition whose entrance makes all the foregoing conditions actual
